title: Images are Achilles’ Heel of Alignment: Exploiting Visual Vulnerabilities for Jailbreaking Multimodal Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper investigates 'harmlessness alignment' and 'jailbreaking' in multimodal models. It evaluates how well models adhere to safety guidelines and 'human values' when faced with malicious prompts, which is a central theme in AI ethics and moral alignment.
